standard_prerequisites.name: The normalised complex functor N
standard_prerequisites.statement: The functor N whose n-th term is the quotient of the n-simplices by the degenerate ones, with the canonical comparison map to s.
standard_prerequisites.use: It is the functor of the statement (source line 4136).

standard_prerequisites.name: Exactness of s
standard_prerequisites.statement: The associated complex functor s is exact (the author's lemma-s-exact, retained as context).
standard_prerequisites.use: It is the first ingredient of the proof (source line 4140).

standard_prerequisites.name: The functorial decomposition
standard_prerequisites.statement: The canonical map N(U) to s(U) is split by a functorial complement, so exactness has to be checked only on the complementary summand (the author's lemma-decompose-associated-complexes, retained as context).
standard_prerequisites.use: It reduces exactness of N to exactness of s (source lines 4140-4141).

core_obligations: Reduce: by the functorial decomposition, exactness of N follows from exactness on the complementary summand, hence from the exactness of s (source lines 4139-4141).

proof_roadmap.step: Combine the exactness of s with the functorial decomposition.
